title: P104: W2 stationary-lifetime composition (conditional κ 0.003656628302607)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope
Focused W2 follow-up, split from #7603. Conditional signed κ = 0.003656628302607; directed crossing 0.00365662830260 < C < 0.00365662830261. Not an unconditional theorem, selected-frontier update, practical speedup or human/formal acceptance.

Uncollapsed #7605 plus ported #7611 stay drops and #7612 contact rechart, followed by39 stationary auxiliary lifetimes. 113 CLEARs =74 original +39 new; peak50 and68 declared labels. Original owned-event chronology and CLEAR contents remain. Fixed allocation reserves17*68=1156 banks, not peak-only compaction.

## Task and overlap
Base main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Scope refined: p104-side-correction; see TASK.json. Only research/p104-w2-stationary-followup,28 files. Exact source #7605 head e1d2756eecf03e146338239fee81772a99ba8d4c and application hash are pinned. This separates the temporary W2 addition from #7603; that addition will be reverted after this PR is confirmed, preserving its original contribution.

Concurrent #7615 overlaps direct pairs(3,746) and(743,245); no priority or exclusive novelty claim for those contractions. W2 does not include its(719,127) pair and is not the same full composition. #7613 is comparator, not construction base.

## Validation
Fresh full candidate-adapted native and17-stage signed applications passed, including 3060 catalogue cases and assembly. 442 affected pairs:512 forward+512 adjoint Gaussian columns, absolute phases and wrong-phase rejection. Exact113 CLEAR certificates and coefficient/wrong-field rejection controls pass. Signed paid110213, productive22461, ordinary785258936 (<1e9), precision context2430. Exact adapter substitutions, fresh receipts and logs included. No original-unmodified acceptance claimed.

Python3.12 standard library. Obtain pinned #7605 source and run from this package:

python reproduce.py --source /path/to/pr7605/research/p104-timed-helper757 --work /short/new-work --stage all
python verify_certificates.py data/word.json.gz evidence/certs-w2.json
python verify_lifetimes.py /existing/output-directory

Registered VERIFY covers certificates only; complete reproduction requires the separately supplied authenticated source tree. Portable prepare exactly reproduces tested scripts. Windows slash normalization is explicit and SHA-pinned; original sources unchanged. No Linux or hosted-CI pass claimed.

## Remaining obligations
Five assumptions: native_all_columns, owned_erasure, compiler, precision_tape, analytic_recovery. Exact CLEAR relations and sequential allocation do not independently implement universal erasure/compiler services. #7609's same-events theorem is not transferred to added events. See README for the conditional lifetime argument.

## Credit
Prepared for SYLforge with substantial Claude Opus5.5 candidate-work and OpenAI verification/integration assistance. #7605 Ali Romman with Codex; #7611 DreamingOfClouds with Claude; #7612 Clear1nsight with OpenAI assistance. Retain Hao Yan/FanPUYen(#7604), SYLforge(#7603), DreamingOfClouds(#7601/#7607 and related), ToikY(#7546/#7544), Rohan Arun(#7113/rechart work), dillona, CubeJerry and all nested-source authors. Apache-2.0; retained notices and full scope in README/BASE-NOTICE.

## Open next questions
Reproduce the authenticated source chain and inspect all adapter substitutions; then review the five framework premises and exact fixed-bank/CLEAR accounting. Conditional certificate checks are not independent human acceptance.
